race.comment: PENCIL ME IN (1) turned in an uncharacteristically poor run last start when 16 metres away in eighth over 1740m at Riverina Paceway. Form prior to that had been solid. No excuses from this advantageous draw. This doesn't look as hard so she is a major player. IRK MCGLURK (3) is racing well with seven top-five finishes in succession, the latest effort a third at West Wyalong over 1740m. Will enjoy a nice run from this favourable starting position. Primary contender in a similar race. MICKEY BE NIMBLE (6) comes right into contention after scoring last start by 1.5 metres at Newcastle over 1609m. SEE ME NO MORE (9) is the best of the rest after finishing sixth over 1609m at Menangle last time out.
